query:
SELECT 
  p.nameAr as parent,
  s.nameAr as subcategory,
  COUNT(t.id) as types_count
FROM product_categories p
LEFT JOIN product_categories s ON s.parentId = p.id
LEFT JOIN product_categories t ON t.parentId = s.id
WHERE p.parentId IS NULL
GROUP BY p.id, s.id
ORDER BY p.`order`, s.`order`
LIMIT 15;
